title: Three Terms and One Short Stand
subtitle: 太空宇宙 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 太空宇宙（人与自然·宇宙探索·太空与宇宙）
meta: 主题语境：太空宇宙（人与自然·宇宙探索·太空与宇宙）　|　核心词汇：globe　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 globe 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the teacher ① turned a globe that no pupil in the room would have described, and he said the turning was the whole of the term. The ② globe, meaning the sphere itself and not the map, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a globe, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ globe in that room had the same short stand beside it, and the ④ globe at the far shelf, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A globe, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the globe was the whole of the matter, meaning the planet and not the sphere. The ⑥ globe, meaning the planet and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; globe, he said, is either something you turn or the only word that means both a sphere and a planet. He said the planet is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ globe had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short stand. The ⑧ globe of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one room and three terms of describing; globe, he said, is either the one at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ globe I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the room. A ⑩ globe, my mother said in 1978, is the only one that improves by being described; every globe, she said, is a planet that has agreed to look like a sphere. She said the planet was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 地球仪；球体（指教室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 地球仪；球体（指那个球本身，与地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：turn a globe 转动一个地球仪
D. n. 地球仪（指留给孩子们用的那一个）
E. n. 地球仪（抽象总称，指一间教室的地球仪之事）
F. n. 地球仪（指计划里写到、被记录过的那一个）
G. n. 地球；行星（指一件事里人人都住在上面却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 地球（抽象总称，指人人都住在上面却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: turned a globe that no pupil in the room would have described
The globe, meaning the sphere itself and not the map
the globe at the far shelf
the globe was the whole of the matter
the globe had become a line in a plan
The globe of the whole thing
A globe, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: turn a globe 意为“转动一个地球仪”，1969 年那位老师转动了教室里没有一位学生肯描述的一个地球仪。
globe 意为“地球仪、球体”，指那个球本身而不是地图，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
globe 意为“地球仪、球体”，指教室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只矮矮的支架。
globe 意为“地球仪”，指最远那层架上留给孩子们用的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
globe 意为“地球、行星”，指一件事里人人都住在上面却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这颗行星就是那件事的全部。
globe 意为“地球”，指人人都住在上面却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个地球仪，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
globe 意为“地球仪”，指计划里写到、被记录过的那一个，到 1974 年这一个成了计划里的一行。
globe 意为“地球仪”，老师十一月写道，整件事的地球仪之事是一间教室和三个学期的描述。
globe 意为“地球仪”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一个，1976 年收起来了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一个。
globe 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，一个地球仪是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
